Package edu.cssd2101.lab03

package edu.cssd2101.lab03
Immutable bookstore domain, small ports, local adapters, and measured pattern examples.
  • Class
    Description
    AddOn
    Decorator adding a fixed fee to any component, including an entire bundle.
    Bundle
    Composite that discounts the sum of already-priced children once at this node.
    BundleBuilder
    Mutable, thread-confined Builder whose completed bundles retain independent copies.
    Catalog
    Catalog port.
    CatalogRepository
    Persistence port for complete inventories; schema and paths belong to its adapter.
    CatalogService
    Application use cases depending on three ports supplied by the composition root.
    CatalogService.Result
    Outcome distinguishes a committed mutation from observer delivery failures.
    Change
    Immutable event captured in the same critical section as its mutation.
    Component
    Sealed, immutable order tree: leaves, discounted bundles, and priced add-ons.
    ComponentVisitor<R>
    Double-dispatch operation with one overload for each concrete component kind.
    DiscountChain
    Immutable Chain of Responsibility: Manager 15%, Director 25%, VP 40%, then refusal.
    DiscountChain.Decision
    Decision retains the requested rate and final price without mutating any material.
    Events
    Synchronous Observer adapter with snapshot iteration and explicit unsubscription.
    Events.Subscription
    Subscription owned by its caller; closing more than once is harmless.
    EventSink
    Event publication port; ordinary observer failures do not roll back committed data.
    FlattenVisitor
    Stateless Visitor collecting every material occurrence in depth-first order.
    InMemoryCatalog
    Monitor-guarded adapter; map, values, and version share one synchronization policy.
    JsonCatalogRepository
    Local JSON snapshot adapter with strict schema and atomic replacement, or an explicit failure.
    Leaf
    A single immutable material occurrence in an order.
    LruCache<K,V>
    Monitor-guarded bounded access-order cache.
    LruCache.Stats
    Captured cache counters; invalidation is distinct from capacity eviction.
    Main
    Useful starting demonstration; extension methods are introduced by the milestones.
    Material
    Immutable catalog value.
    Material.Kind
    Distribution categories; audio and video mean downloads in this model.
    MaterialFactory
    Converts external text into validated immutable domain values.
    Money
    Checked integer-cent arithmetic with explicit HALF_EVEN rounding.
    PrefixIndex
    Immutable-after-construction prefix trie over Unicode code points, ordered by catalog ID.
    SearchService
    Serialized search adapter that rebuilds and invalidates when its source version changes.
    ShippingVisitor
    Stateless shipping operation: books cost 250 cents, magazines 200, downloads zero.
    Snapshot
    Detached, immutable catalog state from one logical instant, ordered by ID.
    Traversals
    Iterator factory for deterministic selection over detached catalog snapshots.
